title: Diebstahlserie aus Handwerkerfahrzeugen – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe

extraction.summaryEn: Police arrested two suspects after three men broke into a parked tradesman's van in Prenzlauer Berg and stole tools; a third suspect fled on foot. Police are seeking other victims of a series of tool thefts from vehicles in Lichtenberg and Pankow.
